say:1:1322553001:1.text: I feel a bit bad, though... I've been so buried in duchy affairs that I haven't had a chance to check in on the kids in Cedartown, even though I've been in town all this time.
say:1:1322553001:1.source_cn: 说起来有些不好意思，我虽然身处雪松镇，可处理公国事务实...
say:1:1322553001:1.male: I feel a bit bad, though... I've been so buried in duchy affairs that I haven't had a chance to check in on the kids in Cedartown, even though I've been in town all this time.
say:1:1322553001:1.female: I feel a bit bad, though... I've been so buried in duchy affairs that I haven't had a chance to check in on the kids in Cedartown, even though I've been in town all this time.

say:2:1322553002:1.text: Magister, the kids here adore you. Would you mind going to check on them? I'd really appreciate it.
say:2:1322553002:1.source_cn: 魔法师大人，您似乎很讨孩子们喜欢，能劳烦您前往过去探望...
say:2:1322553002:1.male: Magister, the kids here adore you. Would you mind going to check on them? I'd really appreciate it.
say:2:1322553002:1.female: Magister, the kids here adore you. Would you mind going to check on them? I'd really appreciate it.

say:3:1322553003:1.text: And if anything comes up, just let me know.
say:3:1322553003:1.source_cn: 如果有什么问题，还麻烦您及时通知我。
say:3:1322553003:1.male: And if anything comes up, just let me know.
say:3:1322553003:1.female: And if anything comes up, just let me know.
